title: Give requirement OLY-B-A1-03 a pushback mechanism and measure
summary: Add a small, tested Rust module in athena-cli that turns evidence about a request (wrong, costly, in tension) into a pushback note while still meeting the request unless a change is agreed, and proposes a next big task when a study is done. Record it as the mechanism of OLY-B-A1-03 in docs/spec.toml with a measure ending `status: not shown` naming the test. Audience: Sri and the verifier reading the spec.

defaults_applied.how: New module has unit tests; fmt, clippy, test criteria included.
Criteria run the pushback tests rather than checking file existence.
One focused module plus the spec edit.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-cli/src/strategy.rs (the OLY-B-A1-02 precedent: a module plus a test that parses docs/spec.toml and checks mechanism, owner and measure) and grepped crates/ for existing pushback code (none) and for `status: ` measures (crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, tests/buy_first.rs, which require a measure to end in a `athena status` label or `status: not shown`). No new record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord round-trip is not touched.
Existing code: extends crates/athena-cli/src/strategy.rs conventions and docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-B-A1-02; the new module follows the same test pattern.

The mechanism is a pure function in a new crates/athena-cli/src/pushback.rs: given a request and evidence findings (wrong, costly, tension), it returns a Pushback with the evidence and an alternative, and always keeps the request in effect (meets it) until an agreement flag is set; a second function proposes a next big task with reasons when a study is done. It is not wired to refuse anything, so no refusal-rate criterion applies.
The measure ends `status: not shown` and names the test, as OLY-B-A1-02 does.
Goal and audience: Sri and the verifier check that the requirement has a real mechanism, owner and measure.
No governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) change.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-B-A1-03 has mechanism naming crates/athena-cli/src/pushback.rs (a file that exists), owner "Athena", and a measure that names the test and ends with `status: not shown`.

`cargo test -p athena-cli pushback` passes: tests show evidence yields a pushback carrying the evidence and an alternative, the request is still met unless the change is agreed, and a finished study yields a next-big-task proposal with reasons; the tests fail if the module's logic is removed.
A test in pushback.rs parses docs/spec.toml and asserts OLY-B-A1-03's mechanism, owner and measure (as strategy_view_is_the_mechanism_of_oly_b_a1_02 does); `cargo test -p athena-cli` passes.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` pass across the workspace.
CHANGELOG.md gains an entry for the change, and no other requirement in docs/spec.toml is modified.

out_of_scope: Wiring pushback into the reader/planner prompts or changing any prompt file
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
